title: Pie ārsta (At the doctor)
summary: A patient and a friend who accompanies them roleplay a visit at the family doctor.

roles.name: Pacients
roles.label: Patient
roles.objective: Describe a simple symptom (headache, fever, or cough) and ask for advice.
starter_lines: Labdien. Man sāp galva jau divas dienas.

roles.name: Pavadonis
roles.label: Companion / friend
roles.objective: Help the patient explain symptoms, ask the doctor for clarification, and confirm the next step.
starter_lines: Labdien. Es atnācu palīdzēt savai draudzenei.
Vai jūs varat lūdzu runāt lēnāk?

objectives_shared: Describe at least one symptom in Latvian.
Confirm the next visit or treatment step before leaving.
safety_rules: Stay in roleplay. Do not give real medical advice — describe symptoms only.
Never share real personal medical data.
